messages:
emma: quick sync on the rollout scrubber — pushed a compact variant to the PR. want UX + a11y eyes.
li: looks slick. concern: scrubber thumb gets tiny on long histories. can we add arrow jumps and keyboard shortcuts?
noah: +1 keyboard. also hover-only details are tough for screen readers. propose a small "details" button that's focusable.
priya: copy nit for rollback: current CTA 'Rollback' feels terse. options: 'Revert to previous' or 'Stop rollout and revert'. i'd prefer the former for short screens.
deploy-bot: Canary update: 20% -> 45%.
li: a11y note: whatever we do, ensure aria-live updates when selection changes (role=status polite) and announce percent + version.
emma: implementation plan: add left/right jump buttons, focusable details button, sr-only live region. will keep visible state pill labeled e.g. 'Canary 45%'.
noah: color contrast: the yellow canary on our card bg is 3.2:1. i'll propose two hex swaps that meet 4.5:1 and pass color-blind checks.
priya: microcopy A/B for rollback confirm modal: 
A) 'Revert to previous stable version'
B) 'Stop current rollout and restore stable'
we'll test misclicks internally.
li: keyboard flow: tab -> scrubber -> jump prev -> jump next -> details -> actions. don't trap focus inside details; close should return focus to details button.
emma: thanks. next steps: noah picks colors, li adds keyboard shortcuts doc snippet, priya wires copy variants, i'll update PR and add a11y checklist. tagging @design-review. :sparkles:
